newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Coffee poised to push higher but pace weak.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Coffee poised to push higher but pace weak.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Robusta coffee futures could attempt to push higher and break out of a tightening range but may not have enough upside momentum to sustain the move, traders and analysts said on Friday.
London's September contract is still drifting in tight ranges as two small trendlines start to converge.
"The range is tightening...but on a tightening like this you normally have quite a good move at the end of it," said Susan Rigg at Chart Analysis.
"I wouldn't be at all surprised if it didn't try to rally but I'm not sure it's going to get very far."
Traders called the London market to open unchanged from Thursday's close although one said an open of as much as $8 higher was also possible.
But with short-term momentum indicators neutral to slightly weaker, the market might not be able to sustain such an upmove over the longer term.
Rigg said $1,900 was likely to act as a key barrier to the upside, while this week's trough of $1,750 would underpin the market.
"You're going to have to close above $1,900 to say there's any chance of going up," she said.
"Conversely, if you start taking out the previous lows we had four days ago you're going to be breaking the small uptrend...but there's a lot of support under that."
But traders said they expected activity in London to be subdued due to the closure of the New York market for the July 4 Independence Day holiday.

According to U.S. forecaster WSC, cold air building over Argentina on Friday was expected to pass off to the south of Brazil's coffee belt as the warm, high pressure dominating the area continued its hold over the region.
